title: Argentinian Toast with Roasted Pak Choi and Herbal Salsa
description: A hearty and flavorful breakfast or snack featuring toasted bread topped with roasted pak choy, a zesty herbal salsa, and a sprinkle of argentinian herbs.
instructions: Toss the chopped pak choy with olive oil and season with salt and pepper.
Roast the pak choy in the preheated oven for 10-12 minutes, or until tender and slightly caramelized.
Meanwhile, toast the bread slices until lightly browned.
In a small bowl, mix together the chopped argentinian herbs, herbs, and a squeeze of lemon juice.
To assemble the dish, top each toasted bread slice with roasted pak choy, a dollop of herbal salsa, and a sprinkle of argentinian herbs.
